title: Galaxy Fold 8 Ultra Trade in Query
body: I've just pre-ordered the samsung galaxy fold 8 ultra 512 gb with trade in. My question is, how do I get away with not sending the phone? I have heard, people just sell it off at marketplace instead. I have paid 500 dollars trade in security charge for the s24 ultra 256 gb already. This is my first time doing trade in. Thanks in advance.
